About Mark

Housing stability is personal

I’m Mark Teran, “Your Mortgage Man,” a Mortgage Advisor with American Pacific Mortgage. I started in the mortgage industry in 1986 while attending college in San Jose, learning the business from my mother.

Growing up in rentals and experiencing financial insecurity made housing stability personal to me. I’ve used what I learned to create stability in my own life, and I want to help others find their path as well.

I joined American Pacific Mortgage in 2019. Today, I help people who want to buy, move, refinance, or make a change in their housing situation understand their options and develop a plan around their needs and long-term goals.

Serving the Greater Sacramento area — Sacramento, Placer, and El Dorado counties — plus clients throughout California and Nevada.

How Mark Helps

Personalized mortgage planning

Helping homebuyers, homeowners, and real estate investors understand their options and choose financing that fits their needs and long-term goals.

01

First-Time Buyers & Down Payment Assistance

What can I afford? How much will I need? Can I qualify? Clear answers and a step-by-step plan — including down payment assistance programs.

02

Buy Before You Sell

Strategies for buying your next home before selling your current one, so your move fits your family’s timing.

03

Self-Employed Borrowers

Financing for self-employed borrowers and anyone whose income requires a different approach to documentation.

04

Mortgage Options During Divorce

Helping people explore financing when navigating the housing challenges that come with divorce.

05

Reverse Mortgages

Including reverse mortgages for home purchases, when appropriate for the client’s situation.

06

Refinance & Home Equity

Comparing refinancing, HELOCs, and second mortgages — with the numbers and tradeoffs explained so you can decide with confidence.

What Makes Mark Different

40 years of experience. Careful listening.

I bring 40 years of mortgage experience, careful listening, and a willingness to work through complicated situations. I take time to understand what each client wants to accomplish, explain the options clearly, and look at how the financing fits their life and long-term goals.

My clients are real people and families, and I take their decisions personally. I’m thorough in preparing their financing and persistent in working through challenges. If buying now isn’t the right move — or they aren’t ready to qualify — I’ll help them understand why and build a plan for moving forward.

For Fellow Members

Who makes a great referral

They don’t need to have everything figured out before we talk — that’s what the conversation is for.

Great referrals

  • Anyone considering buying a home, making a move, refinancing, or accessing home equity
  • First-time buyers unsure where to start or what they can afford
  • People planning their next move
  • Self-employed borrowers
  • Real estate investors

Professional connections

  • Buyer-focused Realtors who value thorough preparation and clear communication
  • Financial advisors
  • Estate planning attorneys
  • Divorce attorneys
  • Professionals whose clients face a larger life or financial decision

Beyond the Business

Get to Know Mark

Wherever I am, I prefer to stay active!

Off the clock

Mountain biking, skiing and snowboarding, boating, paddleboarding, and pickleball. I also enjoy live music and getting together with friends for a barbecue. At home, I like making up melodies on the piano for fun, relaxing with a good movie, and having a little downtime.

Fun fact

I’ve gone on safari in Kenya, zip-lined in Costa Rica, and explored Croatia, Bosnia, and Slovenia. I enjoy discovering new places and having a little adventure along the way.

In the community

Ten years on the Sacramento Association of REALTORS® Can Tree Committee raising funds for the Salvation Army, about 15 years with Woodmore Oaks Neighborhood Watch, and co-founder of Blue Ribbon Professional Network.

A soft spot for dogs

I’ve fostered about seven dogs since losing my two beloved shepherds, Momma Maxie and her daughter, Bambie, who was born in my home.

An accomplishment I’m proud of

Having grown up in rentals and experienced financial insecurity, owning a paid-off home and a debt-free portfolio of seven rental units is especially meaningful to me. My experience in the mortgage business helped me build that foundation — and it’s why I care about helping others make thoughtful decisions that support greater stability, security, and freedom in their own lives.
